description: This PHP class defines a utility script for managing AWS SDK service components within a Composer-based PHP project. It includes methods for removing unused AWS service directories in development or production environments, building service mappings from a manifest, verifying service names, and handling filesystem operations with retries.

classes.name: Aws\Script\Composer
classes.description: A utility class for managing AWS SDK service components within a Composer project, including the removal of unused services based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesInDev
methods.description: Removes unused AWS services in development mode by calling a more general removal method with the dev flag set to true.

methods.name: removeUnusedServices
methods.description: Removes unused AWS services outside of development mode.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesWithConfig
methods.description: Core method that handles the logic for removing unused services based on the provided event, filesystem, and environment settings.

methods.name: buildServiceMapping
methods.description: Constructs a mapping between AWS service namespace attributes and their service names using a manifest file.

methods.name: verifyListedServices
methods.description: Checks that each listed AWS service namespace exists in the service mapping, throwing an exception if any are invalid.

methods.name: removeServiceDirs
methods.description: Removes directories corresponding to unused AWS services, with retry logic for filesystem errors.
